_comment: THE QUARANTINE LIST, read by tests/_quarantine.py on every pytest run of this repository and reported against by
scripts/quarantine_time_caps.py. A listed test keeps running and reports, but does not block, through its deadline
(UTC); from the next day it blocks again. No test is skipped and none is deleted.
Each entry: test (a pytest node id; without a parameter id it covers every parameter), reason, deadline
(YYYY-MM-DD), owner. A missing field, another field, a malformed date or a test listed twice stops the run.
The first entries, 2026-10-25: the two time caps the owner named in Nachtrag 7 of card
CLOUD-640-BESCHLEUNIGER-AUF-MAIN-01, as long as their fixes on other branches are open.
